note: Scripture authority is the Open Word Bible (OWB), Amharic, Balanced edition (CC0), bundled as library/data/bible/owb-am-b.json.gz and read offline (owb-am). Every Scripture quotation was re-quoted to it verbatim (founder decision, 2026-11-18: Amharic quotes OWB everywhere), replacing the 1962 UBS wording the first edition carried. Murray's refrain 'Lord, teach us to pray' is OWB Luke 11:1's span «ጌታ ሆይ፣ … እንዴት መጸለይ እንዳለብን አስተምረን», identical in every block.

A `mined` row is a verbatim OWB span: the whole verse, verses joined, or the shortest span carrying the quoted clause (pieces joined with … where Murray drops words). `self_rendered` rows are the doxology OWB's critical text lacks (Matthew 6:13, rendered from the English), Murray's own petitions that echo Luke 11:1 ('teach us to pray, Our Father'), and allusions or paraphrases in his own voice, left as the translator's prose.
